{
  "name": "bt_link_update_bitmap",

    "v7": "conn_base",

    "v9": "link_info_end",

    "v15": "bit_index",
    "v16": "link_bitmap_base",
    "v17": "bitmap_byte_offset",
    "v18": "bitmap_bit_mask",
    "v19": "bitmap_byte",
    "v21": "min_bitmap_byte",
    "v23": "max_bitmap_byte",
    "v29": "link_index",
    "v30": "bitmap_byte_addr"
  },
  "struct_hints": [
    {"offset": 107, "meaning": "uint8_t link index used to select per-link bitmap arrays"},
    {"offset": 220, "meaning": "uint16_t active-bit or bitmap-entry count"},

    {"offset": 229, "meaning": "uint8_t maximum bitmap byte offset"}
